thesis: A local-first, model-agnostic control plane for persistent embodied AI under explicit control.
release_status: Not yet qualified for V1; all four public proof gates remain open.
known_boundaries: Voice conversation continuity repair PR #2205 was closed without merge and is not included in v2.0.15.

KalivHub has a manual physical Cast proof. Its Home Assistant-first sender, room-first receiver and signed Android test path are green in CI, while physical HAOS/Nest Hub and phone-to-rig-to-Nest Hub acceptance remain open.
Nest Hub microphone input remains unverified after the isolated probe returned NotFoundError.
Cross-surface continuity, restart behavior, latency and extended soak testing remain unqualified for V1.
